net.title.queue: Netplay: waiting for a quick match
net.title.room: Netplay: room {0}, waiting for a player
overlay.about.keys: F1: this window. Hold Tab: fast-forward. Escape or the close button: quit (asks first). The game's data comes from your own disc; nothing of the game is in this program.
overlay.about.title: Tekken Tag Tournament, native PC port
overlay.audio.note: The volumes scale the port's output (the window and TTT_WAV); the game's own sound state is mixed as before. Music: the BGM and movie voices; effects: every other voice. Nothing is played while the game speed is not 1x.
overlay.cheats.note: Unlocking sets the game's own unlock flags: every character, TEKKEN BOWL, THEATER (every ending) and GALLERY. Your next memory card save keeps them, and turning this off does not lock them again. The character select picks the new set at the next game start.
overlay.controls.gamepad_help: Click a button, then press the gamepad's button or trigger (guide or any key cancels).
overlay.controls.gamepads_note: The first four gamepads SDL finds are pads 1-4, in the order they connect. Guide opens this window.
overlay.controls.keyboard_help: Click a key, then press the new key (Escape cancels). F1, Escape and Tab (fast-forward) are kept for the overlay.
overlay.controls.multitap_note: With the multitap, pad 2 is slot 1B and port 2 is empty; recordings keep their own setting.
overlay.controls.stick_note: The game itself reads the d-pad only; the sticks also reach it as they are.
overlay.game.data_checking: USA release so far (TEKKEN.BIN being checked)
overlay.game.pause: Pause the game while this window is open
overlay.game.speed_note: Real time only: the game runs the same frames faster or slower; no sound off 1x.
overlay.net.name: Your name
overlay.net.no_server: No server is built in: run your own (ttt-server) or ask a friend for theirs. See docs/port/matchmaking.md.
overlay.net.restart_note: A session starts the game again from the beginning on both sides.
overlay.net.rtt: Round trip: %u ms; input delay %u frames
overlay.net.update_bad: The server's update notice is not correctly signed: ignored.
overlay.net.update_newer: Version %s is available (nothing is downloaded: get it from a source you trust).
overlay.quit.question: Quit Tekken Tag Tournament?
overlay.ui.announce_game: Announce the game's menus and fights
overlay.ui.screen_reader_note: Speech goes through speech-dispatcher when it is installed. Arrow keys or the d-pad move between the items, Enter or the south button activates. The game's announcements read its memory only: the main menu's item, the characters picked, each round, the life bars by quarters.
overlay.video.texture_note: (replacements/ is read once a run; video.texture_dir or TTT_TEXTURES moves it, on the next start)
setup.empty: No folders or disc images (.iso, .bin, .cue) here.
setup.intro: The game's data comes from your own disc of Tekken Tag Tournament (USA, SLUS-20001); nothing of the game is in this program. Pick the disc: the folder of a mounted disc or of its files, or an image of it (.iso, .bin or .cue). It is checked against the unmodified release, then the game's data file is made and the game starts.
